This image contains problems 3, 4 and 5.

\textbf{3(a)} $x^2+6x+5=(x+3)^2-4$; with $x+3=2\sec\theta$:
\[\boxed{\ln\Big|x+3+\sqrt{x^2+6x+5}\Big|+C}.\]
\textbf{3(b)} $\dfrac{x^{1/3}}{x+x^{1/3}}=\dfrac{1}{x^{2/3}+1}$. Let $x=u^3$, $dx=3u^2du$, $u$ from 1 to 2:
\[\int_1^2\frac{3u^2}{u^2+1}du=3\Big[u-\tan^{-1}u\Big]_1^2=\boxed{3\Big(1-\tan^{-1}2+\frac\pi4\Big)}\approx2.035.\]
\textbf{4(a)} $\int(\ln x)^2dx=x(\ln x)^2-2x\ln x+2x$, so $\int_1^e=e-2$ and the average is \boxed{\dfrac{e-2}{e-1}}\ $\approx0.418$.

\textbf{4(b)} Shells: $V=\displaystyle\int_1^52\pi x\,e^{-\sqrt x}\,dx$. Simpson with $n=4$ ($\Delta x=1$), $f(x)=2\pi xe^{-\sqrt x}$:
\[V\approx\frac13\Big[2\pi e^{-1}+4\cdot4\pi e^{-\sqrt2}+2\cdot6\pi e^{-\sqrt3}+4\cdot8\pi e^{-2}+10\pi e^{-\sqrt5}\Big]\ (\approx12.72).\]
\textbf{5} Measure $y$ up from the bottom edge ($0\le y\le2$). The triangular end has top width 1, so the width at height $y$ is $\frac y2$; a slice has volume $3\cdot\frac y2\,dy$ and is lifted to the spout top, $(2-y)+1=3-y$ ft:
\[W=62.5\int_0^2\frac{3y}{2}(3-y)\,dy=93.75\Big[\frac{3y^2}{2}-\frac{y^3}{3}\Big]_0^2=93.75\cdot\frac{10}{3}=\boxed{312.5\ \text{ft-lb}}.\]
